english.note: Use this colloquial, dismissive word when the exaggeration is being treated as boastful or untrue rather than described neutrally.

examples.english: His claim that he can finish all the food at a banquet by himself is pure hyperbole.
examples.traditional: 佢話自己一個人食得晒成圍菜，完全係吹水。
